cross.title: Cross
cross.intro: Match all four white edges to the bottom center and their side centers.

examples.title: 1. Insert an aligned edge
examples.description: White–green is aligned on top. Insert it with a half turn.
examples.setup: R U R' U R U2 R' F2

steps.text: Turn the front twice. White reaches the bottom and green stays aligned with the green center.

examples.title: 2. Align before inserting
examples.description: Move white–red above the red center, then insert it.
examples.setup: R U R' U R U2 R' R2 U'

steps.text: Move the white–red edge from the back to the right, above the red center.
Send it down with a half turn. The other three cross edges remain in place.

examples.title: 3. Open, insert, restore
examples.description: Insert white–green while temporarily moving, then restoring, white–red.
examples.setup: R U R' U R U2 R' R' F' R

steps.text: Bring the white–green edge to the front-right middle position. This temporarily moves the solved white–red edge.
Insert white–green into the bottom-front cross position.
Restore the right layer and its white–red edge. Check all four side colors.
